name: Prelegal legal document template catalog
description: Standard legal agreement templates sourced from the Common Paper GitHub organization (https://github.com/CommonPaper). All templates are licensed under CC BY 4.0. See templates/LICENSE.txt.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum layered onto an existing software or cloud agreement to cover the use of artificial intelligence features, including training data, model output ownership, and AI-specific warranties and restrictions.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement between a covered entity and a business associate, governing the permitted uses, safeguards, and breach notification duties for protected health information.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a SaaS or cloud subscription, covering the order form, fees, service commitments, data handling, warranties, indemnities, and limitation of liability.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: GDPR-oriented data processing agreement setting out how a processor handles a controller's personal data, including subprocessors, security measures, and international transfers.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement between an early-stage vendor and a design partner collaborating on product development, covering feedback, access to pre-release software, confidentiality, and IP ownership.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard terms of a two-way confidentiality agreement, covering the use and protection of confidential information, permitted disclosures, term, and return or destruction of materials. Incorporated by reference from the MNDA cover page.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Fill-in cover page for the Mutual NDA, capturing the parties, purpose, term, governing law, and signatures, and incorporating the MNDA standard terms by reference.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for a commercial partnership such as reselling or referrals, covering partner obligations, fees and commissions, marketing rights, term, and termination.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-term trial or evaluation agreement letting a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial contract, with a limited scope, pilot period, and simple termination.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for consulting or implementation services delivered under statements of work, covering deliverables, acceptance, fees and expenses, IP in work product, and warranties.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level commitments attached to a cloud or software agreement, defining uptime targets, support response times, exclusions, and service credits as the customer's remedy.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing self-hosted or on-premise software, covering the license grant and restrictions, deployment, maintenance and support, fees, and liability.
